modules.name: Design Deliverables
modules.description: The design outputs to be produced, reviewed and handed over for the Customer Support App.

requirements.title: Clickable Figma design of all key flows

rules.title: Client approval of design before development
rules.description: The client must review and approve the design before development starts.
